map.样本短怎么办？: What If the Sample Is Short?
map.水库调洪演算取设计洪水过程线作入库边界。: The reservoir flood regulation calculation takes the design flood hydrograph as the inflow boundary.
map.洪水频率分析采用皮尔逊Ⅲ型曲线：先由年最大洪峰系列用矩法估计均值、变差系数 Cv: Flood frequency analysis uses the Pearson Type III curve: first estimate the mean, the coefficient of variation Cv, and the skewness coefficient Cs from the annual maximum flood peak series with the moment method; then look up the modular coefficient Φp for the design frequency P (for example 1% for the 100-year flood, 2% for the 50-year flood), and substitute it into Qp = Q̄(1 + Cv·Φp) to get the design flood peak. Cv reflects how dispersed the series is, and Cs/Cv determines the skewness of the curve; when there are fewer than 30 years of data, the regional synthesis method or hydrological analogue interpolation is preferable, to avoid distortion in the tail frequencies.
map.百年一遇指任意年份发生概率 1%，非百年仅一次；长序列里可能多年连发也可能长期不: The 100-year flood means a 1% probability of occurrence in any given year, not that it happens only once in a century; in a long series it may occur in several consecutive years or may be absent for a long time.
map.矩法估计：均值 Q̄ = ΣQi ÷ n；变差系数 Cv = σ ÷ Q̄（σ: Moment method estimate: mean Q̄ = ΣQi ÷ n; coefficient of variation Cv = σ ÷ Q̄ (σ is the standard deviation); skewness coefficient Cs ≈ (2~3)·Cv; design flood peak Qp = Q̄·(1 + Cv·Φp), where Φp is the Pearson Type III modular coefficient (looked up from the design frequency P and Cs)
map.系列少于 30 年宜用地区综合或水文比拟插补，避免小样本高估尾部频率。: For series shorter than 30 years, prefer the regional synthesis or hydrological analogue interpolation to avoid overestimating tail frequencies from a small sample.
map.重现期怎么理解？: How Should You Understand the Return Period?
map.防洪规划按重现期（20/50/100 年）反推设计洪峰与洪量。: Flood control planning back-calculates the design flood peak and flood volume from the return period (20/50/100 years).
map.防洪（设计洪水）频率分析 使用指南: Flood Protection (Design Flood) Frequency Analysis Guide
map.防洪（设计洪水）频率分析工具。输入洪水系列与频率参数，按工程水文方法估算设计洪水: Flood protection (design flood) frequency analysis tool. Enter a flood series and the frequency parameters to estimate the design flood and the return period with standard engineering hydrology methods, for reference in hydraulic flood design (the results are for reference only).
map.：同一系列 P=2%（50 年一遇）洪峰约 3500 m³/s，较百年一遇低约: : In the same series, a P=2% (50-year) flood peak is about 3500 m³/s, roughly 17% below the 100-year peak, so the safety margin drops accordingly.
map.：年最大值系列拟合 P-Ⅲ 曲线，频率 P=1% 查得设计洪峰 Q_p ≈ 42: : Fitting a P-III curve to the annual maximum series and looking up P=1% gives a design flood peak Q_p ≈ 4200 m³/s, used for the spillway and downstream protection standard.
